title: ORACLE_REVIEW_EVIDENCE manifest
description: Evidence manifest for formal document reviews. Mechanical enforcement is scripts/validate_manifest.py (stdlib-only, normative); it verifies structure, candidate binding (exactly one candidate snapshot artifact required), baseline-reference binding (same candidate source identity + declared baseRevision), local artifact accessibility, whole-file SHA-256, and located pair-hash equality via artifact reference maps. Scoped pair hashes are never compared to whole-file hashes. It never claims freshness, semantic coverage, or suitability — those remain parent/Oracle judgments. Declared selectedScope and writerScanRecords are structurally validated only; no evidence-level or full-scan verification is encoded.

invocation.description: Manifest-only invocation metadata (who dispatched this review and when).

reviewContract.description: Parent-owned review contract. Scope, criteria, or protected content asserted only inside an artifact is NOT confirmation.

protectedContent.description: Protected-content declaration; use the string "none" when nothing is protected.

documentType.description: Parent-confirmed document type (e.g. PRD, technical solution, architecture/interface design, delivery document, ADR).

audience.description: Parent-confirmed intended audience of the document.

overlay.description: Overlay metadata. Exactly one distinct representation must be present: either explicit generic/no-overlay ({"generic": true}) or one or more explicit named overlays ("overlays": [...]). Absent, both, or neither prevents criteria selection and is invalid/insufficient evidence. Normative XOR check lives in the validator.

overlays.description: One or more explicitly named overlays to load on top of core criteria.

candidate.description: Parent-declared candidate document identity; binding against the observed snapshot artifact is enforced by the validator.

selectedScope.description: Declared selected scope for this review. Structurally validated only; semantic sufficiency is Oracle's judgment.

writerScanRecords.description: Writer-reported scan records. Claims, not coverage proof — structurally validated only; sufficiency is left to Oracle.

artifacts.description: Declared evidence artifacts. Exactly one artifact with role=snapshot (the candidate snapshot) is required; manifests with only role=base artifacts are invalid (enforced by the validator).

path.description: Local path relative to this manifest.

sha256.description: Whole-file SHA-256 of the local artifact file.

referenceMap.description: Reference map: locator string -> SHA-256 of exactly that located content (e.g. a section, or "whole document"). Pair-form comparison hashes are verified against these maps, never against whole-file hashes.

omissions.description: Declared omissions (may be empty; omissions must be declared, not silent).

comparisons.description: Optional declared comparison claims. Each must name its baseRevision and be backed by a baseline: a scoped role=base artifact (bound by the validator to the same candidate source identity and the declared baseRevision), or a precisely located candidate/base hash pair whose locators resolve in the relevant artifacts' reference maps and whose paired content hashes are equal.
